results.title: TNB Restores Power In JB Within 77 Minutes After Fire Incident At Substation
results.description: Tenaga Nasional Bhd (TNB) has confirmed that a fire broke out at its Kangkar Tebrau Main Intake Substation (PMU) in Johor on Friday (Oct 16), causing electricity supply disruptions across several areas in Johor Bahru and leaving two technical personnel injured.
